research:
I found a likely August 7 baseline of about $328.58, but I couldn't confirm it on Yahoo Finance: the connection to every page I tried to open was refused, so the figures below come from search-result summaries.

## 1. Resolution source
- The question settles on TSLA daily closes on Yahoo Finance. 2026-08-15 is a Saturday, so the Friday **2026-08-14 close** is what counts. [Yahoo Finance](https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/TSLA/)
- 2026-08-07: the base close is probably **$328.58**, up about 2.8% on the day and about 5.6% for the week, per a ts2.tech summary. [ts2.tech](https://ts2.tech/en/tesla-nasdaqtsla-shares-gain-5-6-amid-16-8-billion-terafab-project-and-funding-concerns/)
- The sources disagree a little:
  - TradingKey reported a 3.31% gain on Aug 7. [TradingKey](https://www.tradingkey.com/news/market-movers/262089226-market-movers-tsla-20260807)
  - Polymarket's Aug 7 page gave the Aug 6 close as $319.53, an open of $322.34 and an intraday range of $321.25-$333.73. [Polymarket](https://polymarket.com/event/tsla-close-above-on-august-7-2026)
  - $319.53 x 1.028 ≈ $328.5, which supports $328.58.
- Please check the exact Aug 7 close on Yahoo Finance's history page before relying on it.

## 2. Current status
- 2026-08-08: nothing has settled the question. There have been no trading days since the base close. Five sessions remain (Aug 10-14).

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-08-07: TSLA rose on the Terafab announcement. Tesla, together with SpaceX, is putting about $16.8 billion into a Texas chip plant ("Terafab"), equal to about 38.6% of Tesla's cash and investments at quarter-end. The stock was about +3.5% at $330.63 by 11:02 ET. [ts2.tech](https://ts2.tech/en/tesla-shares-rise-16-8-billion-terafab-project-puts-spotlight-on-capital-plans/)
- 2026-08-07: the whole market rallied after weaker US jobs data eased fears of rate hikes. [ts2.tech](https://ts2.tech/en/tesla-nasdaqtsla-shares-gain-5-6-amid-16-8-billion-terafab-project-and-funding-concerns/)
- 2026-08-07: Seeking Alpha ran the headline "Tesla snaps seven-session losing streak." [Seeking Alpha](https://seekingalpha.com/news/4536819-tesla-set-to-break-seven-session-losing-streak)
- 2026-08-03 and 08-04: Polymarket listed closes of $322.08 (Aug 3) and $327.35 (Aug 4). [Polymarket weekly](https://polymarket.com/event/tsla-week-august-7-2026)
- 2026-08-03: 24/7 Wall St said the shares had lost about a quarter of their value in a month after a Q2 earnings miss. [24/7 Wall St](https://247wallst.com/investing/2026/08/03/tesla-price-prediction-could-the-stock-rally-30-from-here/)
- Q2 2026 results: free cash flow was about -$1.1 billion after $5.8 billion of capex, Tesla's first negative free cash flow in more than two years. Margins are under pressure. [ts2.tech](https://ts2.tech/en/tesla-shares-rise-16-8-billion-terafab-project-puts-spotlight-on-capital-plans/)
- Earlier in 2026, TSLA had an eight-week losing streak that ended in April, when it traded around $385. [Yahoo Finance](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/article/tesla-stock-snaps-8-week-losing-streak-with-earnings-ahead-130116963.html)

## 4. Base rates
- I could not get daily price data. This section is general background, not taken from a source I could open:
  - TSLA usually trades at about 50-65% annualized volatility.
  - That works out to a one-week (five-session) standard deviation of roughly ±7-9%.
  - Weekly moves of ±10% or more happen several times a year.
  - Moves beyond ±25% in one week are very rare.
- Recent behaviour fits that range:
  - About -25% over roughly a month into early August. [24/7 Wall St](https://247wallst.com/investing/2026/08/03/tesla-price-prediction-could-the-stock-rally-30-from-here/)
  - About +5.6% in the week ending Aug 7. [ts2.tech](https://ts2.tech/en/tesla-nasdaqtsla-shares-gain-5-6-amid-16-8-billion-terafab-project-and-funding-concerns/)
- The mean weekly return is close to zero compared with that spread.
- Trend: the stock is down sharply year to date but bounced in the week of Aug 3. It came off a multi-day losing streak just before the base date.

## 5. Other forecasts
- Polymarket lists daily TSLA "Up or Down" markets and weekly "closes week of ___" markets. The weekly market for Aug 10-14 should exist, but I could not find its prices as of Aug 8. [PredScope, Aug 10 market](https://predscope.com/event/tsla-up-or-down-on-august-10-2026), [Polymarket weekly format](https://polymarket.com/event/tsla-week-august-7-2026)
- There is also a Polymarket market on whether TSLA dips to $330 in August, but I found no reliable odds from before Aug 8. [struct.to](https://explorer.struct.to/markets/will-tsla-dip-to-330-in-august-2026)
- I found no Kalshi or Manifold markets, and no dated analyst forecasts for this specific week.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution (Aug 10-14)
- 2026-08-12, 8:30 ET: July CPI release. This is a major macro risk because the market is focused on rates. [BLS](https://www.bls.gov/schedule/news_release/cpi.htm)
- 2026-08-13 and 08-14: July PPI and retail sales are probably due around then (my assumption from the usual schedule; I didn't confirm the dates).
- Tesla-specific items:
  - Follow-up on how Terafab will be funded (capex and cash worries).
  - Any China sales or insurance-registration figures (usually published weekly).
  - Robotaxi or FSD news.
  - Posts from Elon Musk.
- I could not confirm any scheduled Tesla corporate event during Aug 10-14.
